label: Expiration (TTL)
type: the time-to-live after which an item is treated as deleted. Settable per item and boundable per bucket or collection by data:max-ttl-setting.
note: Promoted with data:max-ttl-setting because the interesting fact is the interaction between them, not either alone: the bucket-level maximum silently caps a per-item TTL, and takesPrecedenceOver - promoted this round - exists to state exactly that.
